recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-13063 unless a future work group decision changes RequestOrchestration's authored date semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13063 was Published/Persuasive for the CDS RequestGroup resource and requested renaming RequestGroup.occurrenceDateTime to authoredOn because the element identifies when the group was authored, not when something occurred.
initial_application: SVN 11650, represented by git commit 5d266baea46cdf6acd410d4818e2a6e4eb4870db, changed the RequestGroup spreadsheet and examples from occurrenceDateTime to authoredOn and updated the associated mappings.
additional_context: FHIR-24619 later renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration for R5. The current fhir.ini lists requestorchestration as an active CDS resource, marks RequestOrchestration approved, and maps the old RequestGroup name to RequestOrchestration. Current RequestOrchestration source, search parameters, examples, mapping exceptions, and invariant fixtures use authoredOn; occurrenceDateTime is absent from source/requestorchestration.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current build-scope source edit is needed.
